reason: The FKT is a 21-mile four-peak link-up (Mesachie, Katsuk, Kimtah, Cosho) from Easy Pass, not a Cosho-only scramble.
The FKT page is for Thomson's West Ridge (low-fifth technical), a different line from our East Ridge walk-up.
The FKT follows the Cascadian Couloir via Longs Pass, not the 5.10d West Face Wall Gorillas Direct.
The FKT is named for Mt Thomson's West Ridge, a different peak from Kendall Peak.
The FKT follows the Cascadian Couloir, not the 5.12a West Face Wall route.
FKT describes Cathedral Pass, PCT, Peggy's Pond, SE ridge to the West Peak; WTA's Mount Daniel page describes the same Peggy's Pond ridge route ending in a few class 3 moves.
FKT goes trailhead to lookout and back; WTA describes the same trail to the summit lookout as the page's single main route.
FKT is the Sulphide Glacier route car to car; WTA confirms the Shannon Ridge trail is the approach climbers use for the Sulphide Glacier.
The page's GPS track is a Monitor Ridge file with a trailhead-summit-trailhead category, and WTA describes Ptarmigan Trail then Monitor Ridge to the rim from Climbers Bivouac.
FKT's primary route is Ingalls trailhead over Longs Pass up the Cascadian Couloir, and Wikipedia names the Cascadian Couloir as Stuart's standard route.
